0022600210.text: The Warriors (7-3, on a seven-game winning streak) host the Pelicans (4-6, on a two-game losing streak) in Golden State's 11th game of the 2026-27 season. Golden State is 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, and 5th in the West, with a 5-1 home record, while New Orleans is 5th in the Southwest, 4 games back, 11th in the West, and 1-3 on the road. Golden State is missing Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Will Richard (thumb), and New Orleans is without Trendon Watford (ankle), Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis), Yves Missi (knee bruise), and Zion Williamson (rest). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, though New Orleans beat them 113-109 in the last meeting on February 24, 2026, in New Orleans.
